headline: Selected geothermal option for Missituk Elementary and CM at Risk for Roberts Elementary ARP project.
summary: The vote on the Missituk option was 6-1, with the mayor opposed. A consent agenda that included a $250 donation to the Medford High School DECA Club was also approved. Staff also gave updates on the before and after school program and the quarterly finance report.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda 5-0, with two members absent.
Selected the geothermal option for the Missituk, 6-1.
Selected CM at Risk for the Roberts Elementary ARP project, 7-0.
